steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Statistical Enquiry Cycle (SEC) is a structured approach to carrying out a statistical investigation. | Key Fact: The five/six stages are: Plan, Collect, Process, Present, Interpret and Evaluate. | Key Fact: Some specifications list five stages (combining Interpret and Evaluate); others list six. | Key Fact: Plan: Define the hypothesis, identify variables, decide on methods and sample.

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Full-Mark Response A student investigates whether taller people have larger shoe sizes. They collect heights and shoe sizes from 30 classmates, calculate the mean for each group, draw a scatter graph and conclude the hypothesis is supported.
